summary.value: When you or an ally fails a Ritual of any discipline within your Patron's domains, erase up to (SL x 2) Favour sections

system.description: When you or an ally fails a Ritual of any discipline within your Patron's domains, erase up to (SL x 2) Favour sections to add a bonus to that Ritual's Magic Check equal to the number of sections erased, potentially turning the failure into a success.
